raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows (60 of 200) carry numeric region codes '01'-'04' instead of region names. silver_customers only upper-cases the region and never applies the code-to-name mapping in raw_region_map, so codes leak into silver_customers and split gold_region_daily.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
